'''Naath''' is a man from [[Mat Cauthon]]'s memories.

== History ==
Mat remembers the stories of Naath and the [[San d'ma Shadar]] when convincing [[Egwene]] that they cannot retreat.{{ref/book|14|36}}

== Trivia ==
* Naath is named for Helen Cousins, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''. Naath is a username, and has no connection to George R. R. Martin's ''A Song of Ice and Fire''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
